marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 this morning then
diminishing to northwest 15 late overnight. Wind diminishing to light Thursday
morning then becoming southeast 15 Thursday evening. Snow with a risk of freezing rain changing to scattered
flurries this morning and ending overnight. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures plus 1 falling to minus 5 this
evening. Freezing spray late this afternoon and tonight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less early Thursday
morning.<br/>
